note: The commercial cut. One line per caption cue in cues.commercial.json, written to fit the gap before the next cue. Edit the text and re-run VARIANT=commercial node scripts/narrate.mjs; it reports any line that overruns its beat.
lines: A primary care practice with three neighbourhood clinics, run as one.
Patients choose the clinic that suits them, and keep the same clinician.
Booking takes four short steps, starting with what the appointment is for.
Then where, and with whom. Choosing any location searches all three clinics at once, one book behind all of them.
The times offered are live availability, worked out from that same book. The patient picks one that suits them.
A few details, and nothing more is asked for.
The booking is confirmed on the spot, with a reference the patient can keep.
The front desk reads the same schedule. Not a copy, not a second system. The booking is already there.
Elsewhere in the day, a patient cancels.
That time goes straight to the waitlist.
Two of the three people waiting suit this time, each with its reason.
Reception offers it, with the message already written.
The time is held, with a deadline everyone can see.
The patient accepts, and the agenda updates the moment it lands.
The freed time is filled, and the cancellation stays on the board.
And one view covers all three clinics, worked out from the same records.
Occupancy, time held, and time still free.
